salonVip.label: VIP Lounge — Business network
salonVip.description: A private room, dim lighting, glasses of synthetic champagne. Merchants, brokers, people doing each other favors. Here, connections are worth more than gold.

c0.label: Pay the entry fee and network (400 cr)
c0.msg: -400 cr. You leave with new contacts and obligations. +{{amount}} cr, +30 rep.

c2.label: Free entry (Rep ≥ 80)
c2.msg: They recognize you. You walk in without paying. +{{amount}} cr, +40 rep.

arena.label: Combat arena
arena.description: Legal fights (roughly). The crowd wants blood.

c1.label: Bet on a fighter (300 cr)
c1.lose: He collapses in round three. -300 cr.

grandCasino.label: The Grand Samy Scotty Casino
grandCasino.description: The entrance is a wall of light. Clinking chips, synth music, the smell of luxury fuel. Samy Scotty turned this station into a temple of chance. Anyone can play. Anyone can lose.

c0.label: Low table — bet 150 cr (55% chance → +200)
c0.win: The ball lands on your number. +200 cr.
c0.lose: Missed. The house keeps the 150 cr.

c2.label: High stakes — bet 1500 cr (45% → +2400)
c2.win: The dealer pales. You pocket 2400 cr.
c2.lose: Lost. -1500 cr. The dealer doesn't even smile.

c3.label: VIP table — bet 3000 cr (40% → +6000) [Rep ≥ 60]
c3.win: The VIP table applauds. +6000 cr, +10 rep.
c3.lose: No one says a word. -3000 cr.

c4.label: Hack the algorithms (Hacker — 75% → +1800 cr)
c4.win: [HACK] Odds rigged. You win consistently. +1800 cr.
c4.lose: Samy has good technicians. Detected. -500 cr, -20 rep.

c5.label: Watch the surrounding madness
c5.msg: Someone loses their fortune. Someone else wins theirs. Nothing new.

machinesSamy.label: Samy's Machines — Underground bets
machinesSamy.description: In the back room, bets on illegal fights streamed live. Slot machines rigged, but not too much. The smell of affordable transgression.

c0.label: Slot machine — 200 cr (3 reels, jackpot ×6, two matching ×1.5)

c2.label: Bet on an illegal fight — 600 cr (35% → ×3)
c2.win: Your fighter demolishes the opponent. +{{amount}} cr.
c2.lose: He drops in thirty seconds. -600 cr.

dealer.label: Look for a dealer
dealer.description: In the low alleys, someone sells things that don't officially exist.

c1.label: Buy info on a convoy (400 cr)
c1.msg: -400 cr. The tip leads to a convoy. +{{amount}} cr.

fence.label: Local fence
fence.description: He takes anything with no questions asked. Below-market prices.

c0.label: Sell all cargo (+25% black-market price)
c0.msg: +{{amount}} cr. Cargo sold on the black market.

armouryAccess.label: Access to the military armory
armouryAccess.description: A sergeant waves you over from the corridor. "You look like someone who knows how to handle gear. The armory sells some surplus — not on the official catalog."

c0.label: Buy special ammunition (400 cr)
c0.msg: -400 cr. He slides two crates over without looking. +2 Special ammunition.

dataMarket.label: Data market
dataMarket.description: Brokers sell classified information. Some of it is worth a fortune.

c1.label: Sell your own information
c1.msg: Your intel is valuable here. +{{amount}} cr.

rumorNetwork.label: Former inmates' network
rumorNetwork.description: Former prisoners have contacts everywhere. Their network is worth gold.

c0.label: Buy info on a convoy (200 cr)

c1.label: Offer your services as a smuggler

alanossaContact.label: Contact with Alanossa's lieutenants
alanossaContact.description: Lieutenants have been watching you since you arrived. A nod — an invitation.

c1.label: Decline
c1.msg: He notes your refusal. It counts.

tournamentRegister.label: Check the Tournament poster
tournamentRegister.description: A massive poster spans the entrance corridor. TEN FIGHTS. TEN OPPONENTS. The last one standing walks away with glory and gold. A doorman stares at you from the arena entrance.

c1.label: Look at the board of past champions
c1.msg: Names. Stars next to some. Red crosses next to most. You can count the survivors on one hand.

tournamentOngoing.label: Tournament in progress — Next round
tournamentOngoing.description: You're registered. The crowd waits. The next opponent is getting ready behind the door.

c1.label: Withdraw (disqualification)
c1.msg: You throw in the towel. The crowd boos. No shame in surviving.
